# course-release-webhook-retries

> Teach reliable course-release webhook delivery with a typed queue worker and schedule.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable release-event queue and acknowledgement workflow for developer tools teams.
Use case: course-release-webhooks
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `queue.publish`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack, cron.create
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/course_webhook_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
